Manage composes on the server

The 'start' and 'start-ostree' commands can optionally upload the results,
view the full upload profile reference here:
https://osbuild.org/docs/user-guide/uploading-cloud-images/

-a, --api
=1 Server API Version to use
-j, --json
[=false] Output the raw JSON response instead of the normal output
--log
="" Path to optional logfile
-s, --socket
="/run/weldr/api.socket" Path to the server's socket file
--test
=0 Pass test mode to compose. 1=Mock compose with fail. 2=Mock compose with finished.
--timeout
=240 Timeout to use for server communication. Set to 0 for no timeout

TOML profile for uploading to AWS


    provider = "aws"


    [settings]


    accessKeyID = "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"


    secretAccessKey = "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"


    bucket = "AWS_BUCKET"


    region = "AWS_REGION"


    key = "OBJECT_KEY"


  TOML profile for uploading to GCP


    provider = "gcp"


    [settings]


    bucket = "GCP_BUCKET"


    region = "GCP_STORAGE_REGION"


    object = "OBJECT_KEY"


    credentials = "GCP_CREDENTIALS"


  TOML profile for uploading to Azure


    provider = "azure"


    [settings]


    storageAccount = "your storage account name"


    storageAccessKey = "storage access key you copied in the Azure portal"


    container = "your storage container name"
